agyos_skill.intent: Use when creating, optimizing, auditing, or positioning a freelancer's professional identity, personal brand promise, LinkedIn profile, or portfolio case studies.
agyos_skill.instructions: Build a professional identity that attracts high-value clients, establishes authority, and converts visitors into leads. To utilize this skill's core methodologies, copy-paste templates, or AI prompts, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md](references/01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md) | Personal Brand Architecture | Trust Triangle, Brand Promise, Anti-Positioning, Credibility Stack | | [01B-LINKEDIN-OPTIMIZATION.md](references/01B-LINKEDIN-OPTIMIZATION.md) | LinkedIn Optimization System | Profile SEO, Headline Formula, Content Calendar, 15-15-15 Prospecting Ritual | | [01C-PORTFOLIO-POSITIONING.md](references/01C-PORTFOLIO-POSITIONING.md) | Portfolio & Niche Positioning | Case Study STAR-M Template, GitHub Optimization, Niche Matrix, Tiered Service Design | When asked to define a freelancer's brand or positioning: - Reference [01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md](references/01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md) to audit their **Trust Triangle** (Competence, Credibility, Reliability). - Help them construct a formal **Brand Promise Statement**: *"I help [ideal client] achieve [specific outcome] through [unique mechanism]."* - Define their **Anti-Positioning** boundaries (what they do *not* do) to clarify expertise and shield against scope creep. When asked to write or improve a LinkedIn profile: - Reference [01B-LINKEDIN-OPTIMIZATION.md](references/01B-LINKEDIN-OPTIMIZATION.md) to apply the **7-Second Profile Test**. - Write a 220-character headline following the formula: `[Role / Core Niche] + [Outcome / High-Value Result] + [Trust Anchor / Proof] + [Call to Action]`. - Structure the About section with hook-driven narrative copywriting, value pillars, and a clear call to action. - Guide them through the **15-15-15 outbound prospecting ritual** (15 DMs, 15 Comments, 15 Connections daily). When asked to write a case study or design a portfolio page: - Reference [01C-PORTFOLIO-POSITIONING.md](references/01C-PORTFOLIO-POSITIONING.md) to structure projects using the **STAR-M Case Study Template** (Situation, Task, Action, Result, Metrics). - Ensure case studies emphasize business outcomes and hard metrics (revenue, speed, accuracy) over tutorial-style descriptions. - Set up a three-tiered **Good-Better-Best service matrix** (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) to maximize project deal size. | Concept | File | Section | One-Line Summary | |---------|------|---------|------------------| | Trust Triangle | [01A](references/01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md) | 1.1 | Competence × Credibility × Reliability = Trust | | Brand Promise | [01A](references/01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md) | 1.2 | "I help [X] achieve [Y] through [Z]" | | Anti-Positioning | [01A](references/01A-PERSONAL-BRAND.md) | 1.3 | What you DON'T do defines your value |
